in_hebrew.name: Othilie
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Fairy of the forest
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Othilie הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek mythology, Othilie was a nymph who lived in the forest. She was believed to protect travelers and offer them guidance. Her name is derived from the Greek word 'othos,' meaning 'wood,' and 'leos,' meaning 'lion,' reflecting her association with the forest and her protective role.
